subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: What cross-session run progress API, if any, should OpenClaw expose for peer `sessions_send` runs?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent API shape controls authorization, redaction, buffering, replay, and channel delivery policy across agent/session boundaries.

options.title: Add `sessions_subscribe` plus `agent.events`
options.body: Expose a separate opt-in progress reader backed by permission checks, bounded replay, redaction, and focused docs/tests.

options.title: Extend `sessions_send` with progress mode
options.body: Keep one tool entry point but add explicit streaming/progress options and the same authorization and redaction contract.

options.title: Defer peer progress streaming
options.body: Keep the current wait/history/final-announce model and document polling as the supported workaround until structured process events are designed.

recommendation.title: Add `sessions_subscribe` plus `agent.events`
recommendation.body: Expose a separate opt-in progress reader backed by permission checks, bounded replay, redaction, and focused docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans sessions_send, A2A delivery, gateway agent RPC, and session management surfaces touched by this design.
